notes: GL data grants of a group (journals, accounts, cost centres 1/2, estimate periods per company; read by APP_RULES_GL / APP_PROC_GL / APP_RULES_AR); derived level and end position, grant-all and add-main-accounts buttons, deleting a main account removes its sub accounts (APP_RULES3_SE, see processes/ACPASS_ADMIN.md)

AC_PASSWORD_ENTRY.ENTRY_TYPE.lov: select c.entry_type || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(c.entry_desc_e, c.entry_desc) else c.entry_desc end d, c.entry_type r from ac_trn_codes c where c.entry_year = :PAGE_ENTRY_YEAR and (c.entry_year, c.entry_type) in (select t.entry_year, t.entry_type from ac_company_entry t where t.company_code = :PAGE_COMPANY_CODE) order by c.entry_type

AC_PASSWORD_MASTER.ACCOUNT_NUMBER.lov: select m.account_number || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(m.account_name_e, m.account_name) else m.account_name end d, m.account_number r from ac_master m where m.account_number in (select t.account_number from ac_company_master t where t.company_code = :PAGE_COMPANY_CODE) order by m.account_number

AC_PASSWORD_COST1.COST_CODE.lov: select c.cost_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(c.cost_desc_e, c.cost_desc) else c.cost_desc end d, c.cost_code r from ac_cost_centers c where c.cost_code in (select t.cost_code from ac_company_cost1 t where t.company_code = :PAGE_COMPANY_CODE) order by c.cost_code

AC_PASSWORD_COST2.COST_CODE.lov: select c.cost_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(c.cost_desc_e, c.cost_desc) else c.cost_desc end d, c.cost_code r from ac_cost_centers2 c where c.cost_code in (select t.cost_code from ac_company_cost2 t where t.company_code = :PAGE_COMPANY_CODE) order by c.cost_code

AC_PASSWORD_EST_PERIOD.PERIOD_CODE.lov: select p.period_code || ' - ' || case when app_sec.lang = 'en' then nvl(p.period_name_e, p.period_name) else p.period_name end d, p.period_code r from ac_estimate_periods p where p.period_code in (select t.period_code from ac_company_est_period t where t.company_code = :PAGE_COMPANY_CODE) order by p.period_code
